**Vancouver, British Columbia – Integra Resources Corp. (“Integra” or the “Company”) (TSXV: ITR; NYSE American: ITRG)** is pleased to announce the publication of its 6th annual Sustainability Report (the “Report”) covering the producing Florida Canyon Mine (“Florida Canyon”) and the DeLamar Project (“DeLamar”) and Nevada North Project (“Nevada North”) (together, the “Development Projects”). The Report highlights the Company’s first full year as owner and operator of Florida Canyon in northern Nevada and, at DeLamar, the signing of a historic Relationship Agreement with the Shoshone-Paiute Tribes of the Duck Valley Reservation. The Report aligns with the International Financial Reporting Standards (“IFRS”) Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (“SASB”) Metals and Mining Standard and covers Integra’s activities and performance from January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025.


**Environmental, Social, and Governance (“ESG”) Highlights:**


- Environmental:


- Achieved zero reportable spills at Florida Canyon and the Company’s Development Projects.


- Maintained strong water management performance, with no exceedances of water discharge permit limits.


- Enhanced baselines for stream and wetland mitigation work by surveying approximately 122 acres of wetlands and approximately 116,000 feet of streams at DeLamar.


- Partnered with Trout Unlimited to explore a potential U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Good Samaritan remediation project for abandoned mine sites in the Jordan Creek watershed, outside DeLamar.


- Continued support of the Jordan Valley Rangeland Fire Protection Association (“RFPA”) and worked in collaboration to combat the threat of rangeland wildfires.


- Social:


- Signed the Relationship Agreement with the Shoshone-Paiute Tribes of the Duck Valley Reservation.


- Integrated all Integra employees into a combined benefits and retirement program.


- Contributed more than US$400,000 to local communities through donations, sponsorships and in-kind support.


- Supported over 23,400 people through community programs and strategic investments.


- Connected with more than 14,500 individuals through meaningful outreach and stakeholder engagement efforts.


- Incurred one lost-time injury and seven reportable injuries.


- Implemented a hazard recognition program at Florida Canyon as a leading safety indicator, with more than 300 hazards reported and rectified in December 2025 alone, demonstrating strong workforce adoption.


- Operations:


- Advanced a major Florida Canyon fleet expansion, commissioning a Hitachi EX3600 shovel, a CAT 992HL wheel loader, and two new CAT 785 haul trucks in 2025, with six additional CAT 785 haul trucks added to the mining fleet in 2026.


- Governance:


- In 2025, 20% of corporate objectives were ESG-linked, and 90% of those objectives were met.


**George Salamis, President, CEO and Director of Integra commented:** “2025 was a defining year for Integra. In our first full year operating Florida Canyon, we began to establish a mining operation built on our values, investing in the people, equipment and systems needed to sustain the mine in the years ahead. At DeLamar, years of meaningful engagement culminated in a Relationship Agreement with the Shoshone-Paiute Tribes of the Duck Valley Reservation, a milestone we are particularly proud of. Together, these achievements reflect our commitment to responsible mining and building lasting relationships with the communities where we operate. As we continue towards our goal of becoming a mid-tier precious metals producer, we remain committed to accountability, environmental stewardship and the well-being of our people and communities.”


The 2025 Sustainability Report is available on Integra’s website using the following link:


[https://integraresources.com/esg/esg-reporting](https://integraresources.com/esg/esg-reporting)


**About Integra Resources**


Integra is a growing precious metals producer in the Great Basin of the Western United States. Integra is focused on demonstrating profitability and operational excellence at its principal operating asset, the Florida Canyon Mine, located in Nevada. In addition, Integra is committed to advancing its flagship development-stage heap leach projects: the past producing DeLamar Project located in southwestern Idaho and the Nevada North Project located in western Nevada. Integra creates sustainable value for shareholders, stakeholders, and local communities through successful mining operations, efficient project development, disciplined capital allocation, and strategic M&A, while upholding the highest industry standards for environmental, social, and governance practices.


**ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS**


George Salamis
